description: BIP Reporting: the BI Publisher catalog of an Oracle Fusion pod from this PC — browse folders (kept on this PC until Refresh), index the whole catalog and search it, read a report's parameters and output formats, run it (dates in the report's own format, date buckets joined into one table, big outputs in chunks), the result as a grid (search, sort, Excel / CSV) or the output file (download, open), every run kept on this PC, favourites, a dashboard of report cards (dates that move with today), and the SQL behind a report (its data model, into Fusion SQL). Ported from the WMS app's Oracle BIP Reporting module. The desktop app makes the calls (desktop/lib/bipReports.js at /__bip/*) with Fusion SQL's pods; rules shared with it: resources/js/bipKit.js.
